units: <cite ref="Berakhot 43a:13">Ber. 43ᵃ</cite> <he>משתעלה תִמְרָתוֹ</he> when the smoke column of incense rises.
Ḥull. 112ᵃ משתעלה תימרתו when the smoke of meat on coals rises.—Pl. תִּמְרוֹת bare hyssop stalks.

Par. XI, 7 (Maim. reads תְּמָרוֹת seed-capsules, v. preced.); Tosef. ib. XI (X), 6. Ib. 7 היונקות … ת׳ לא הניצו כל עיקר yon’ḳoth are undeveloped capsules, timroth are stalks that have not blossomed at all; (oth. opin.) ת׳ גבעולין שלא גמרו וכ׳ timroth are undeveloped capsules &c.
